name: Midjourney
h1: Midjourney ARR: ~$500M, Zero Funding, Profitable Since Year One.
intro: Midjourney has never disclosed a revenue figure. Everything below comes from third-party estimates — Forbes, Sacra, GetLatka and Value Add VC — which converge on roughly $500M of annualized revenue in 2026, earned entirely from flat subscriptions with zero outside funding.

milestones.note: Open beta in July 2022; trackers estimated revenue passed $1M/month within the first weeks of paid access.
Widely cited estimate of ~$200M annualized revenue — achieved with no sales team, no paid marketing and roughly 40 employees.
Estimates cluster around $300M for 2024, up ~50% YoY, as the subscriber base approached 20M registered users.
Estimates around $400M+, up roughly a third YoY; the company stayed fully bootstrapped and profitable.
Current third-party estimates put annualized revenue at ~$500M — roughly $4.7M of revenue per employee on 40–107 staff.

modelTitle: How Discord Subscriptions Became the Entire Business.
modelParagraphs: Midjourney sells exactly one thing: flat-rate subscriptions through Discord and its web app. Four tiers run roughly $10, $30 and $60 per month, with a ~$120 'Mega' tier at the top — billed monthly or at a ~20% annual discount. There is no free tier (only limited web trials), no API product, and no enterprise contracts.

Because there is no sales motion and no paid acquisition, effectively all revenue is self-serve subscription — an unusually pure model that has kept the company profitable since around its sixth month, at roughly $4.7M of estimated revenue per employee.
revenueMix: ~$10 / $30 / $60 per month, plus a ~$120 Mega tier; monthly or ~20% discounted annual billing.
Unlike peers, Midjourney sells no developer API or contracts — subscriptions are the entire business.
No sales team or paid marketing; Discord and word of mouth carry acquisition.

faqs.a: Unknown officially — Midjourney has never disclosed revenue. Third-party estimates (Forbes, Sacra, GetLatka, Value Add VC) put annualized revenue around $500 million in 2026, up from ~$300M estimated for 2024 and ~$200M for 2023.

faqs.q: How Much Funding Has Midjourney Raised?
faqs.a: Zero. Midjourney is fully bootstrapped, has no sales team and no paid marketing, and has reported profitability since roughly its sixth month of operation.
Four flat subscription tiers of roughly $10, $30 and $60 per month plus a ~$120 Mega tier, billed monthly or annually at about a 20% discount. There is no free tier and no API.

faqs.q: How Reliable Are These Revenue Estimates?
faqs.a: They are not company-confirmed. Figures are triangulated from subscriber counts, pricing and analyst models, and different trackers estimate 2024–2025 revenue anywhere from $300M to $500M+. Treat the timeline as directional.

faqs.q: How Big Is the Midjourney Team?
faqs.a: Reports place headcount between roughly 40 and 107 people. At ~$500M estimated revenue, that is about $4.7 million per employee — among the highest ratios ever reported in software.
